The Founding of Hero Law.text: Hero law was Japan's answer to the chaos years: ban dangerous Quirk use for everyone, then license a trained few to use their Quirks for the public. The criminal code alone had failed, because the police could not match the strongest offenders. The new laws made public Quirk use illegal without permission, required every Quirk to be registered, and created a profession of heroes paid by the state for the cases they resolve. The Hero Public Safety Commission was founded to run the system as a single authority, setting standards, approving hero courses and issuing licenses, while the police kept the power to arrest, investigate and detain. The framework has been amended many times, but its core has held for generations.
